input.prompt: EDIT IMAGE 1 as the pixel sprite template. Image 1 is approved Wang Lin Pixel02 enlarged exactly 8x. Image 2 supplies only these costume colors and identity details. IGNORE image 2 body proportions, pose and fine shading completely. Target logical canvas64x96, body80 pixels high with about44px overall width and foot(32,88), displayed as exact integer pixel enlargement; do not smooth or add smaller detailed pixels. Preserve pixel scale from input1 rather than painting a big illustration to shrink later. This is a new NPC neutral master for review, not an animation.
